style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website for elementary students in Taiwan. Landscape 3:2. Characters: Taiwanese (East Asian) children and adults drawn in a gentle Japanese anime picture-book style, natural expressions, age-appropriate child proportions (elementary-school kids look 7-12 years old). Setting: present-day Taiwan (Taiwanese schools, streets, homes, parks). Taiwanese school uniform = plain polo shirt or white shirt with shorts/skirt, or sports PE uniform; NO red neckerchief, NO red scarf. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, paper texture visible. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy brown, generous ivory breathing room; no bright flat digital colors, no glossy 3D, no imitation of a named artist. Every person has five fingers per hand, arms clearly attached to shoulders, feet grounded and pointing naturally. scene_prompt: 成語：採『接連不斷』義。台灣城市道路旁，僅畫前景母子兩人觀看車流，車子從近到遠一輛接一輛穿過同一路口，旁側再以兩個小景呈現日光移動後仍持續有車通過。車距密而有序，清楚表達延續不斷，不畫塞住不動的車陣；駕駛與遠景乘客不露手部，母子雙手放大、各五指，刪除數十小人物。【重點】沿用根層唯一鉛筆水彩與米白紙紋；每手五指、支撐合理，無文字、類字、品牌、水印與紅色頸飾。
